posts.en:
dsh-perm-guard is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Auto-approval permission guard: a middle tier between workspace-write and danger-full-access — auto-allows safe operations inside trust directories, always asks a human for destructive ones, with 11 per-category switches and an audit trail.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bbb3633bf32e61db05ed.html
